conditions.evidence: investigating **Parkinson's Disease (PD)** and its associated cognitive impairments
conditions.label: Parkinson's disease

modalities.evidence: Resting-state fMRI data were collected from participants

output.population: Human; healthy control (HC), Parkinson's disease with normal cognition (PD-NC), and Parkinson's disease with mild cognitive impairment (PD-MCI); ages 60–94
output.summary: Resting-state functional and structural MRI from healthy controls and Parkinson's disease patients with normal cognition or mild cognitive impairment, part of a longitudinal study. Organized following the BIDS specification and acquired on a Siemens scanner.
